parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the target image whose sky you want to replace. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: ReplaceImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the reference image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
